statement: Within the exact yeast mitochondrial record, the 35 already-observed mitochondrial MOP occurrences will be overrepresented in internally classified mitochondrial intergenic address space relative to all valid chrM 16-nt windows.
support_condition: observed/expected >1 and exact binomial upper tail <=0.05; strong support <=0.01.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before removing the organellar override from any of the 35 observed chrM MOP occurrences or calculating the chrM internal background.
